title: recompose-networking-templates-and-introduce-region-aware-provider-locking
creator: Ava Mitchell
description: Problem: Our current networking templates mix global and region-specific resources in large, hard-to-reason-about Terraform entrypoints. Provider versions are declared inconsistently across workspaces which causes drift during provider upgrades and prevents safe, staged rollouts. Goal: Recompose networking templates into a thin global orchestration layer and small region-aware modules, and introduce a provider-locking strategy that pins provider versions per-region with an operator-friendly upgrade path. This reduces blast radius for provider upgrades, improves module testability, and makes future cloud-provider migrations (minor version bumps and replacements) safer and auditable.
acceptance_criteria: A new networking module layout exists: modules/network-global (orchestration), modules/network-region (region-specific resources) and a modules/provider-locker that centralizes provider version pinning
At least one non-production workspace (staging-us-east-1) is migrated to the new layout with no service interruption and terraform plan/apply success documented
Provider versions are declared centrally and pinned per-region via provider-locker, with a documented upgrade checklist and gating smoke tests
Automated integration tests run in CI per-region that validate create/destroy on a subset of resources (VPC, subnets, route tables, IGWs) within 30m and report drift
Rollout strategy documented: staging -> canary production region -> full production, with rollback steps and monitoring dashboards updated
